problem: The section says it gives a 'six-way market list' but then lists seven items (posted price, on-demand, reserved/subscription, spot, auction, bidding and bargaining, differentiated/priority). Quiz Q5 asks for six categories, and its answer drops reserved/subscription — the very scheme used in Worked example 1. A student cannot tell whether reserved is one of the categories.
fix: Change the lead to 'a common seven-way market list is below', keep all seven bullets, and change Q5 to: list the seven common market-model pricing categories — posted price, on-demand, reserved or subscription, spot, auction, bidding and bargaining, and differentiated or priority.
